arxiv-2106-16021.title: Invariant measures of torus piecewise isometries
arxiv-2106-16021.creator: Michael Blank
arxiv-2106-16021.description: Abstract We study measure-theoretical aspects of torus piecewise isometries. Not much is known about this type of dynamical systems, except for the special case of one-dimensional interval exchange mappings. The last case is fundamentally different from the general situation in the presence of an invariant measure (Lebesgue measure), which helps a lot in the analysis.

arxiv-2112-14886.title: dimorphic properties of Bernoulli random variable
arxiv-2112-14886.creator: Taekyun Kim, DAE SAN KIM, Hyunseok Lee, Seong-Ho Park
arxiv-2112-14886.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Taekyun Kim, DAE SAN KIM, Hyunseok Lee, Seong-Ho Park. The aim of this paper is to study a dimorphic property associated with two different sums of identically independent Bernoulli random variables having two different families of probability mass functions. In addition, we give two expressions on sums of products of degenerate Stirling numbers of the second kind and Stirling numbers of the first kind connected with those two different sums of identically independent Bernoulli random variables. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification

arxiv-2306-07393.title: Investigation of Λ ⁡ ( 1405 ) \Lambda(1405) as a molecular pentaquark state
arxiv-2306-07393.creator: K. Azizi, Y. Sarac, H. Sundu
arxiv-2306-07393.description: Abstract Λ ⁡ ( 1405 ) \Lambda(1405) is one of the interesting particles with its unclear structure and distinct properties. It has a light mass compared to its non-strange counterpart, despite the strange quark it carries. This situation puts the investigation of this resonance among the hot topics in hadron physics and collects attention to clarify its properties.

arxiv-2306-14069.title: Waypoint Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Supervised Learning with Intermediate Targets
arxiv-2306-14069.creator: Anirudhan Badrinath, Yannis Flet-Berliac, Allen Nie, Emma Brunskill
arxiv-2306-14069.description: Abstract Despite the recent advancements in offline reinforcement learning via supervised learning (RvS) and the success of the decision transformer (DT) architecture in various domains, DTs have fallen short in several challenging benchmarks. The root cause of this underperformance lies in their inability to seamlessly connect segments of suboptimal trajectories.

arxiv-2412-19552.title: Contrast-Optimized Basis Functions for Self-Navigated Motion Correction in Quantitative MRI
arxiv-2412-19552.creator: Elisa Marchetto*, Sebastian Flassbeck*, Andrew Mao, Jakob Assländer, E. Marchetto, S. Flassbeck
arxiv-2412-19552.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Elisa Marchetto*, Sebastian Flassbeck*, Andrew Mao, Jakob Assländer, E. Marchetto, S. Flassbeck. Purpose: The long scan times of quantitative MRI techniques make them vulnerable to motion artifacts. For MR-Fingerprinting-like approaches, this problem can be addressed with self-navigated retrospective motion correction based on reconstructions in a singular value decomposition (SVD) subspace. However, the SVD promotes high signal intensity in all tissues, which limits the contrast between tissue types and ultimately reduces the accuracy of registration.

arxiv-2502-02389.creator: Pau Colomer, Christian Deppe, Holger Boche, and Andreas Winter
arxiv-2502-02389.description: Abstract We investigate deterministic identification over arbitrary memoryless channels under the constraint that the error probabilities of first and second kind are exponentially small in the block length 𝐧 \mathbf{n} , controlled by reliability exponents 𝐄 𝟏 , 𝐄 𝟐 ≥ 𝟎 \mathbf{E_{1},E_{2}\geq 0} .

arxiv-2512-23493.title: Joint Link Adaptation and Device Scheduling Approach for URLLC Industrial IoT Network: A DRL-based Method with Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2512-23493.creator: Wei Gao, Paul Zheng, Peng Wu, Yulin Hu, Anke Schmeink
arxiv-2512-23493.description: Abstract In this article, we consider an industrial internet of things (IIoT) network supporting multi-device dynamic ultra-reliable low-latency communication (URLLC) while the channel state information (CSI) is imperfect. A joint link adaptation (LA) and device scheduling (including the order) design is provided, aiming at maximizing the total transmission rate under strict block error rate (BLER) constraints.

pmc-10575282.title: Elettaria cardamomum (L.) Maton Essential Oil: An Interesting Source of Bioactive Specialized Metabolites as Inhibitors of Acetylcholinesterase and Butyrylcholinesterase
pmc-10575282.creator: Marta Pavarino, Arianna Marengo, Cecilia Cagliero, Carlo Bicchi, Patrizia Rubiolo, Barbara Sgorbini, Daniela Rigano, William N Setzer
pmc-10575282.description: Elettaria cardamomum (L.) Maton (Zingiberaceae family) is a plant traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Chinese medicine. In this work, the essential oil of E. cardamomum was found to inhibit the enzymes AChE (62.6% of inhibition, IC50 24.9 μg/mL) and BChE (55.8% of inhibition, IC50 25.9 μg/mL) by performing an in vitro colorimetric assay using the Ellman method.

pmc-11349866.title: Intraosseous mandibular schwannoma managed via submandibular approach: a case report with a review of previously published cases
pmc-11349866.creator: Abdulaziz Alabdulkarim, Shaikha AlDukhail, Abdullah A Al Qurashi, Abdullatif Abuhaimed, Omar Alshameri, Abdulaziz Alghamdi, Alwaleed K Alammar, Abdulrahman Alsahabi
pmc-11349866.description: A 40-year-old female presented with right mandibular swelling. A panoramic radiograph showed a unilocular radiolucency from the mandibular angle to tooth #46. Biopsy confirmed a schwannoma. Surgical resection was performed via a submandibular approach with a reconstruction plate. Teeth 46 and 47 were extracted. Surgery was complication-free, and histopathology confirmed the tumor’s benign nature.

pmc-11437901.title: Characteristics of locus coeruleus functional connectivity network in patients with comorbid migraine and insomnia
pmc-11437901.creator: Changlin Wang, Sishi Chen, Zihan Cheng, Shiyong Xia, Chang jun Fei, Li Ye, Liang Gong, Chunhua Xi, Yu Wang
pmc-11437901.description: BackgroundMigraine and insomnia are prevalent conditions that often co-occur, each exacerbating the other and substantially impacting the quality of life. The locus coeruleus (LC), a brainstem region responsible for norepinephrine synthesis, participates in pain modulation, sleep/wake cycles, and emotional regulation, rendering it a potential nexus in the comorbidity of migraine and insomnia.

pmc-11482325.title: Small sharks, big problems: DNA analysis of small fins reveals trade regulation gaps and burgeoning trade in juvenile sharks
pmc-11482325.creator: Diego Cardeñosa, Elizabeth A. Babcock, Stanley K. Shea, Huarong Zhang, Kevin A. Feldheim, Stephan W. Gale, DeEtta Mills, Demian D. Chapman
pmc-11482325.description: Many shark species have been overexploited for international markets, including fins for shark fin soup in Southeast Asia. Previous studies highlighted the value of large, threatened shark species, regulated under CITES Appendix II. However, sampling biases may have overlooked small shark species. Here, we address this by identifying species from ~4000 small shark fins in Hong Kong.

pmc-12502387.title: Study of socioeconomic differences of long-term PM2.5 exposure and population mortality risk - based on 345 cities from 2000 to 2019 in China
pmc-12502387.creator: Surong Zhao, Xingyu Zhang, Ronghang Liu, Junyan Liu, Xiaoqian Shao, Wanru Zhao, Jiu Wang, Yang Zhao, Chunlei Han
pmc-12502387.description: BackgroundPrevious studies have thoroughly evaluated the association between long-term exposure to PM2.5 and mortality, but the effect of socioeconomic status on the association remains controversial.MethodsWe utilized the data of all-cause mortality per year, concentration of PM2.5, socioeconomic and demographic characteristics for 345 cities in China from 2000-2019.

pmc-12582930.title: Superoxide- and semiquinone-linked activation of molecular hydrogen in metal-catalyst-free solution
pmc-12582930.creator: Toru Ishibashi, Enjuro Harunari, Genki Ishihara, Tetsushi Niiyama, Mami Noda-Urata, Nobuaki Komori
pmc-12582930.description: The therapeutic effects of molecular hydrogen (H2), particularly in ischemia-reperfusion (I/R) injury and deleterious inflammation, have been increasingly attributed to its modulation of redox balance. However, the precise molecular mechanisms underlying H2-medated redox modulation, particularly in mitochondrial reverse electron transfer (RET)-driven superoxide (O2•-) generation, remain unclear.

pmc-12653942.title: The Gene Ail for the Attachment–Invasion Locus Protein of Yersinia enterocolitica Biotype 1A Strains Is Located on the Genomes of Novel Prophages
pmc-12653942.creator: Jens Andre Hammerl, Stefan Hertwig
pmc-12653942.description: The attachment–invasion locus protein Ail of pathogenic Yersinia strains is an important virulence factor, both for invasion of eucaryotic cells and for serum resistance. In other Yersinia strains, e.g., those belonging to biotype (BT) 1A of Yersinia enterocolitica, ail has only occasionally been described. Sequence analysis of 370 BT 1A isolates in our laboratory revealed 41 (11.1%) which were ail-positive.

pmc-12736584.description: To investigate the effects of varying degrees of shading on the photosynthetic characteristics of Spuriopinnella brachycarpa (Kom.) Kitag. experiments were conducted under five shading treatments: 0% (full sunlight), 20%, 40%, 60%, and 80%. The results demonstrated that shading significantly influenced plant growth and photosynthesis.
